channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Trump sends Fed chair Warsh nomination to Senate
item.description: President Donald Trump today officially nominated former Federal Reserve Gov. Kevin Warsh to be the U.S. central bank’s next chair, the White House said, putting the president one step closer to installing a rate-cut-friendly Fed chief.

item.title: CDC deploys staff to curb South Carolina’s measles outbreak
item.description: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention staff will arrive in South Carolina next week to help the state contain the largest measles outbreak in the country in decades years, a state official said in a briefing on Wednesday.

item.title: More repatriation flights as Middle East airspace closure strands thousands
item.description: LONDON/DUBAI/HONG KONG >> Repatriation flights were due to depart from the Middle East today as governments rushed to bring home tens of thousands of citizens stranded by the intensifying U.S. and Israeli conflict with Iran.

item.title: Stocks close up on Iran diplomacy hopes; tech leads rebound
item.description: U.S. stocks closed up today, after a news report that Iran had signaled openness to talks and a pledge by President Donald Trump to steady oil markets calmed investor anxiety about the Mideast clash.

item.title: Amazon cuts more jobs; this time in robotics unit
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO >> Amazon on Tuesday confirmed it laid off staff across its robotics unit, with at least 100 white-collar jobs affected, two people familiar with the matter told Reuters.

item.title: Man, 36, indicted in alleged murder over a missing iPad in Kapolei
item.description: An Oahu grand jury indicted a 36-year-old man for Friday’s Kapolei shooting death of a 26-year-old woman, and the shooting of his 16-year-old ex-girlfriend and her aunt.

item.title: Hiker airlifted from Lanikai Pillbox trail with ankle injury
item.description: Honolulu firefighters this morning rescued a Lanikai Pillbox hiker with an injured ankle.

item.title: Lou Holtz, who coached unbeaten Notre Dame to a title, dies at 89
item.description: Lou Holtz, who coached six major colleges to bowl games and revived a floundering Notre Dame football program, taking the Irish to an unbeaten national championship season in 1988, has died in Orlando, Florida. He was 89.

item.title: Man, 33, indicted for attempted murder, assault of police officer
item.description: A 33-year-old man has been indicted on charges of first-degree attempted murder of a law enforcement officer, second-degree assault and second-degree attempted assault, according to the Honolulu Prosecutor’s Office.

item.title: Senate backs Trump on Iran strikes, blocks bid to limit his war powers
item.description: WASHINGTON >> U.S. Senate Republicans backed President Donald Trump’s military campaign against Iran today voting to block a bipartisan resolution aiming to stop the air war and require that any hostilities against Iran be authorized by Congress.
